result.summary: The page is generally well laid out, but some text has low contrast.

issues.description: The inactive bottom navigation labels are light gray on white, making them difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker gray that meets text contrast requirements.

issues.description: The promotional banner’s smaller white text has low contrast against the brighter green background.
issues.suggestion: Darken the banner background or adjust the text color to improve contrast.
